title: COSTCO Monopoly Game - Hasbro- Everything Included
descriptionText: The Costco Monopoly Game by Hasbro is a party game designed for 2 or more players, with a theme centered around Costco. This complete game set includes everything needed to play, making it a perfect addition to any game night. With a recommended age range of 8 and up, this updated version of the classic Monopoly game is sure to entertain both children and adults alike with its fun and competitive gameplay.
